howItWorks.subtitle: Simple for customers. Clear for your business and your team.

scan.title: Scan
scan.body: The customer scans a QR code at the desk or on a team card. They see your business and the person who helped them.

tip.title: Tip
tip.body: They choose an amount and pay online. The tip goes to that team member or the whole team, if you set it that way.
tip.note: No app. No account for customers.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.body: They rate the experience and leave a short note. Tips and feedback land in one dashboard, tied to the people who earned them.
feedback.note: Useful signal. Not just a review site.

faq.title: Answers to <accent>what you're wondering</accent>
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about tipping, feedback and getting your team started.

q1.question: How do customers tip?
q1.answer: They scan your QR code, choose an amount and pay online. There is no app to download and no account to create.

q2.question: Can customers tip a specific person?
q2.answer: Yes. A tip can go to the team member who helped them, or be shared with the whole team, depending on how you set it up.

q3.question: Do I need any extra hardware?
q3.answer: No. A QR code at the desk, table or counter is enough to start. It works alongside your existing setup, with no POS integration needed.

q4.question: What happens to the feedback customers leave?
q4.answer: Customers can rate their experience and add a short note. Feedback lands in the same dashboard as tips, tied to the people who earned it, so you hear about problems before they become public reviews.

q5.question: How do team members join?
q5.answer: Add your team from your business account. Employees and managers use a separate staff sign-in from business owners, and their tips and positive feedback stay with their profile.

q6.question: Who processes the payments?
q6.answer: Payments are handled securely by Viva.com, so card details never touch your business or your team.
